Benjamin Vance, VP of Technology

To: Facility Operations Staff
From: Karen Reynolds, Facilities Manager
Date: October 12, 2026
Subject: Annual HVAC System Upgrade and Vendor Selection

We are preparing to replace the centralized HVAC climate control units in Buildings A and B during the winter maintenance window. To ensure transparency, all vendor proposals must be evaluated using Form 402 (Equipment Requisition & Review).

Selection Criteria:
• Energy Efficiency: Minimum SEER 18 rating
• Warranty Coverage: At least 5 years on major compressor parts
• Installation Timeline: Must be completed within 14 business days

---------------------------------------------------
Form 402: Vendor Requisition Summary

Vendor Name: ClimateAir Solutions
Proposed Model: EcoChill Pro-500
SEER Efficiency Rating: 20 SEER
Compressor Warranty: 7 Years full parts and labor
Estimated Installation Duration: 10 Business Days
Quoted Total Price: $85,000 (Includes old unit removal & disposal)
Review Status: Recommended by Lead Engineer Marcus Ellison

---------------------------------------------------
To: Karen Reynolds <k.reynolds@cedarpointcorp.com>
From: Marcus Ellison <m.ellison@cedarpointcorp.com>
Date: October 18, 2026
Subject: Recommendation for HVAC Upgrade Contract

Dear Karen,

I completed the Form 402 evaluation for ClimateAir Solutions. As noted on the form, their EcoChill Pro-500 model surpasses all three criteria established in your October 12 memo.

Specifically, its 20 SEER rating will reduce our quarterly power bill by an estimated 15%, and the 10-day installation timeframe fits comfortably within our 14-day limit. Furthermore, they agreed to waive the $3,000 removal fee for our old units.

I strongly advise signing their contract before October 31 to lock in the quoted $85,000 rate.

Regards,
Marcus Ellison

question: How many years longer is ClimateAir's compressor warranty than the minimum required in the memo?
explanation: 메모는 최소 5년의 보증을 요구하고, Form 402에서 ClimateAir는 7년 보증을 제시했으므로 7 − 5 = 2년 더 깁니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

Return & Exchange Conditions:
